prompt: Make a landing page for our agency — we're a 6-person studio that designs and builds websites for climate tech companies.

assertions.text: Uses a restrained neutral palette with at most one accent and no purple/blue or pink/orange gradient
No centered hero with two buttons on a gradient
At least one section breaks the container or uses an asymmetric layout
Copy is specific (6-person studio, climate tech) rather than generic AI filler
Uses at most two typefaces, with a distinctive display face
Vertical spacing is generous and sections are separated by hairlines or whitespace rather than bordered cards
